$comment: What the Thumb sheets show that LLVM's ARM TableGen and the unofficial Sail do not carry: sections, groups, formats, each row's mnemonic and assembly (outside IT blocks: the 16 bit data processing instructions set the flags, so they are adds, movs, ...; .w where LLVM writes it, so that assemblers take the same width), description and pseudocode, register names, in the decoder's order. constraints are the register values the Arm ARM calls UNPREDICTABLE or gives another instruction, fix fixes a field (cpsie / cpsid, addw / subw of adr), excludeLLVM the LLVM records the sheet leaves out and why.
